# Regional Hospital Stroke Capabilities (WWAMI)

Static, public-source reference map of hospital stroke-center certifications
(CSC / TSC / PSC / ASR), state stroke designations, and 24/7 endovascular
thrombectomy (EVT) capability across Washington, Alaska, Idaho, Montana, and
Wyoming, with transparent distance/transport planning estimates and a
user-adjustable expansion-planning heuristic.

- Site: https://rkalani1.github.io/telestroke-expansion-map/
- Source: https://github.com/rkalani1/telestroke-expansion-map

## Data

- /hospitals.json — the only dataset the app loads. Top-level metadata:
  schema_version, data_version, last_verified, generated_at, primary_sources,
  coverage_note, certification_definitions, certifying_bodies. One record per
  hospital: cmsId (CMS CCN), address, city, state, zip, latitude, longitude,
  strokeCertificationType (CSC/TSC/PSC/ASR/null), certifyingBody,
  certificationDetails, hasELVO (24/7 thrombectomy), dataSources, verified.
- Authoritative version and verification dates are the data_version and
  last_verified fields inside hospitals.json. As of this file's last update:
  data_version 2026.07.18.1; full dataset verified 2026-07-04; watch-list
  re-checked 2026-07-18. Certification and EVT changes require two
  independent public sources before they are applied.
- Not a complete census of acute-care hospitals in the five states — see
  METHODOLOGY.md §1 (scope) and §8 (limitations).

## Methods

- /METHODOLOGY.md — sources, certification nomenclature, transport-time model
  (haversine × 1.25 road factor; 55 mph ground + 8 min overhead; 150 mph air
  + 25 min overhead), expansion-scoring heuristic, integrity checks, limits.
- /CHANGELOG.md — release and data history.
- /COMPLIANCE.md — public-data boundary for this repository.

## Scope

Planning reference built from public sources (CMS, Joint Commission, DNV,
state registries). Not for clinical decision-making, live transfer routing,
or dispatch, and not an official state Department of Health product.
Transport times are order-of-magnitude planning estimates, not operational
dispatch times. Expansion scores are transparent heuristics computed in the
browser; they make no claims about clinical operations, staffing, volume, or
telestroke contract status.
